about.metaTitle: About Menuyukti | Digital menus for restaurants
about.metaDescription: Create a living digital menu for your online presence — and use AI tools built for how restaurants actually run.
about.title: Your menu. Online. Ready for guests.
about.intro: Turn your dishes into a living online presence — one link you control, not a PDF that goes stale.
about.introFollow: Register, publish your dishes, and share a link or QR to give your venue a clear online presence.
about.introClose: Your menu stays easy to update — and ready to share wherever guests find you.
about.presenceTitle: An online presence built around your menu
about.presenceBody: With Menuyukti, your dishes and prices live in one place guests can open from a link or QR code.
about.presenceBodyFollow: Update your menu when you need to, and keep the same link across your table, window, DMs, and listings.
about.howtoStep2: Create your digital menu — add your dishes and prices.
about.howtoStep3: Share — send the link or put a QR on the table, window, or receipt.
about.benefitBody: Update items when you need to. Guests open it on any phone — no app required.
about.benefitEmphasis: One link. Everywhere you need to be found.
about.platformTitle: Digital menu for guests. AI for the restaurant.
about.platformBody: Menuyukti also includes AI tools that help with planning, content, and everyday restaurant decisions.
about.platformBodyFollow: Your menu for guests. AI tools for your team — in one place.
about.closingBody: Create your digital menu and put your restaurant online — in a workspace made for hospitality.
about.closingTagline: Menuyukti — your menu, online. AI for the work behind it.
